Gene-cell count matrix was generated by cellranger count v2.0.2 against Ensembl GRCm38.p5 reference genome.
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Filtered count matrix from cellranger count is stored in three files: barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv and matrix.mtx.
